class.name: GDScriptReflection
class.brief_description: Read-only GDScript reflection and dynamic-proxy API, reached through [code]godot.reflection[/code].

method.name: create_delegating_proxy
method.description: Builds a delegating proxy for the trait or abstract type [param type] in the "intercept some, pass the rest through" style. [param type] must be a trait or abstract type that extends [RefCounted]. Every contract method whose name is a key in [param interceptor] routes to that advice [Callable], invoked as [code]advice.call(method_name, args, target)[/code] so the advice can "proceed" by calling [code]target.callv(method_name, args)[/code]. All other contract methods, and all contract property reads and writes, forward to [param target]. [param target] must implement [param type] (that is, [code]target is type[/code] must hold); otherwise [code]null[/code] is returned and an error is printed. The returned object satisfies [code]is type[/code], so it can be assigned to a variable of that type.

method.name: get_method_info
method.description: Returns the descriptor for the method named [param method] declared by [param target]'s script or one of its base scripts, in the same shape as the entries of [method Object.get_method_list]. [param target] may be a [Script] type or an instance. Returns an empty [Dictionary] if the method is not declared.

method.name: get_methods
method.description: Returns the descriptors of every method declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts, in the same shape as [method Object.get_method_list]. [param target] may be a [Script] type or an instance. Returns an empty array if [param target] has no script.

method.name: get_properties
method.description: Returns the descriptors of the variables declared by [param target]'s script and its base scripts, in the same shape as [method Object.get_property_list]. Only declared [code]var[/code]s are returned (category and group headers are omitted). [param target] may be a [Script] type or an instance.

method.name: implements_trait
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param target] conforms to [param trait]. [param target] may be a [Script] type or an instance; [param trait] may be a trait type (resolved to its identity) or a trait identity name ([String] or [StringName]). A trait conforms to itself and to every trait it uses.
